title: safety-hunch-log-ines-2026
content:
Purpose / context:
- Working personal scratchpad for SOC2 readiness (security + availability focus). Worst-case: rough notes that help me remember assumptions and friction points when I hand this to the audit lead.

Top-of-mind risks / hypotheses:
1) Key lifecycle: KMS/HSM integration exists in Private deploys but documentation for rotation schedule across Dedicated pools is murky. Hypothesis: rotation event isn't propagated to ephemeral inference nodes consistently. Risk: stale keys in local caches -> prolonged access after revocation.
2) Service routing fallbacks: smart routing (regional/cost tiers) introduces non-uniform config for access controls — need policy matrix for what tier inherits which ACLs.
3) Evidence gaps: we have telemetry for request latency and token counts but not per-tenant KV-cache hit rate tied to model-version rollouts. Hard to correlate perf regressions to rollouts.

Controls to map / quick sketches:
- IAM and least privilege: map roles (api, infra-agent, ops-runner, customer-admin). Note: check github:infra/iam-roles.md for missing service accounts.
- Change control: PR-based deploy + canary config, but need logs that show who approved canary->prod. Candidate evidence: GitHub approvals + console rollout events.
- Key management: rotation proof = KMS audit log + node sync events. TODO: ask infra for node-side rotation webhook events.
- Incident response: playbook exists but no post-incident attestation template. Draft a one-page attestation for SOC2 incidents.

Quick checklist (what I personally need to gather):
- [ ] Export KMS rotation audit (last 12 months) and correlate with node sync times (ask infra/sre).
- [ ] Pull list of service accounts, last-used timestamps. (github audit + cloud IAM).
- [ ] Document fallback routing policy table (latency-tier, cost-tier, region) and owner for each row.
- [ ] Capture console UI event stream for rollout approvals (console-and-rollouts team).
- [ ] Find eval prompt sets and quality-monitoring alerts mapping to model rollouts.

Open questions / notes to ask others:
- Anika: do we currently emit any per-request tenant ID to our observability traces when requests are routed to Dedicated? (I recall some redaction config interfered).
- Ben: can you confirm whether Reserved capacity (Dedicated) nodes persist any cached model weights across deploys that would need a separate evidence path?
- SRE: what retention window do we have for node-level debug logs? Auditor will want at least 6 months for incidents.

Mini risk matrix (quick):
- Key rotation mismatch: S (High), L (Medium), Action: immediate evidence pull + design note for webhook-based sync confirmation.
- Incomplete approval trail for rollouts: S (Medium), L (High), Action: instrument console to attach PR/approval ids to rollout events.
- Telemetry blindspot on KV-cache per-tenant: S (Medium), L (Medium), Action: prototype a metric that tags kv-cache hits by tenant/model-version for 30 day pilot.

Draft language snippets for control mapping doc (copyable):
"Control: Access keys are managed via corporate KMS with automated rotation and audit logs. Rotation events are recorded in the KMS audit stream and reconciled with node-side sync logs to ensure no stale credentials remain in inference runtime caches."

Random brain dump (messy):
- Could use short-lived signing keys for model payloads, rotate every 24h for private/on-prem nodes to limit blast radius.
- Think about a small telemetry agent that posts a heartbeat after key rotation; can be lightweight and only used during attestations.
- Evidence packaging: create a zipped bundle that contains (1) relevant GitHub PRs, (2) console rollout event JSON, (3) KMS audit slice, (4) node sync events. Label by control id.

Next steps (this week):
1) Sync with infra on KMS logs (Anika)
2) Draft a one-page incident attestation template and circulate (me)
3) Build a short query to pull recent rollout events from console (ask: console team for read-only access)
4) Run a 30-day KV-cache metric pilot on one Dedicated pool (if Ops approves)

Notes-to-self: keep this doc informal. Move cleaned mapping into Confluence under Trust Ops once stable.

-- Ines
(updated quick notes 2026-03-05)
